name: Patanjali Foods Limited
summary: Patanjali Foods Limited, established in Indore in 1986, mainly processes oilseeds and refines crude oil for edible use in India. It reports in seed extraction, vanaspati, oils, food and wind power segments. Its products include edible oils, vanaspati, bakery fats, textured soya protein, flour, honey and coffee, as well as seeds, soaps and toiletries.
